holdings.name: Bharat Heavy Electricals Ltd

what_changed.text: Reported Q2 FY2027 net profit surge of 120% to ₹821 crore with revenue rising 24% to ₹9,300 crore and an order book of ₹2.58 lakh crore.
Approved ₹500 crore in additional manufacturing facilities at Haridwar along with an internal merger effective November 1, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: Representing 1.89% of fund assets, BHEL supports the 13.7% Industrials allocation with strong trailing 6-month (+40.42%) and 1-year (+84.16%) momentum.

portfolio.statement: WhiteOak Capital Mid Cap Fund has declined 2.63% over the past 3 months and 3.67% over the past month, pressured by steep corrections in fintech and life insurance holdings despite strong counter-rallies in IT, pharma, and capital goods.
interp: Financials exposure (27.3%) is split by sharp divergence: fee and capital market businesses like Motilal Oswal and banking stability in Federal Bank are overshadowed by steep drawdowns in PB Fintech and Max Financial.
Technology (12.1%) and Healthcare (14.4%) positions have served as key performance shock absorbers, with Coforge and Laurus Labs each contributing over +0.50% in 3-month gains.
portfolio.line: Gains in enterprise tech and pharmaceuticals are being cancelled out by regulatory and margin headwinds in non-bank financials.

drivers.text: PB Fintech declined 30.86% over 3 months amid regulatory paper concerns and FY2028 earnings forecast cuts.
Max Financial Services dropped 19.10% over 3 months amid expense-of-management compliance concerns.
Coforge gained 26.37% over 3 months driven by expanding AI enterprise frameworks and broader midcap IT momentum.
Bharat Heavy Electricals reported a 120% YoY jump in Q2 PAT with order book strength reaching ₹2.58 lakh crore.

themes.title: Financial Intermediation Headwinds vs Capital Markets
themes.text: Retail-facing platforms face regulatory scrutiny and margin checks, whereas capital-market players continue expanding infrastructure.

themes.title: Industrial and Export Capex Growth
themes.text: Manufacturing and active ingredient expansion continue to deliver quarterly earnings growth and balance-sheet reinvestment.

macro.why: Scrutiny around commission structures and expense-of-management regulations impacts non-banking distribution models.
Resilience in corporate digital transformation spending supports engineering center expansions.

priced_in.text: Substantial profit contraction for PB Fintech with consensus forecast cuts of 72% for FY2028 already visible in the 32-month price lows.
Expectations of healthy growth in life insurance earnings ahead of Q2 results previews.

could_change.title: Regulatory Clarity for Online Insurance Brokers
could_change.text: Final guidelines on IRDAI proposals could either validate management's view that 70% of business is unaffected or force downward structural revenue adjustments.

could_change.title: Execution of Capital Goods Order Backlogs
could_change.text: Realization of BHEL's ₹2.58 lakh crore order book into billable revenue across coming quarters will test operational capacity expansions.

portfolio.risk_note: A heavy 27.3% Financials concentration exposes the fund to systemic policy changes and derating across fintech and private insurers, while portfolio beta remains slightly elevated at 1.03.
